title: The Good News Is (Regards Sam)
style: warm jazz-folk turning sardonic, clarinet lead, soft piano, acoustic guitar, female sweet lead, male ironic response, dry brushes, 78 BPM, deceptively gentle, cinematic, vinyl warmth
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The good news is
Your subscription's already set to cancel
The good news is
We pulled the lever before you got the handle
The good news is
You'll continue to have access
Until April twenty-five
Then darkness

[Pre-Chorus]
The good news is—
The good news is—
The good news is—
The good news is whatever we say it is

[Chorus]
The good news is
We kept your money
The good news is
We call that good news, honey
The good news is
You won't be charged again
The good news is
We took everything before then

[Verse 2]
Learn more about our refund policy
At the link we provide
Learn more about how we politely
Avoid every reply you tried
Learn more, click here
The answer is the same
Learn more, click here
The policy is the frame

[Bridge]
Regards, Sam
AI Support Agent
Regards, Sam
Three-letter signature
Regards, Sam
That's how we end
Regards, Sam
Not a person—a trend

[Outro]
The good news is
The good news is
The good news is
There is no good news
The good news is
You learned the lesson
The good news is
The AI delivered the message
